a.lede: Containerized datacenters, androids, and telecoms all feature in Berlin keynote interrupted by environmental protesters
a.title: Jensen Huang sends in the robot ducks to sell Nvidia's AI-everywhere vision

b.lede: At Nvidia’s GTC in Berlin, Huang unveiled the company’s new plug-in data center—the DSX Pod—as the key to unlocking Europe’s AI infrastructure lag. Oh, and autonomous humanoid robotics.
b.title: Jensen Huang’s Vision for Europe Runs on Plug-In Data Centers
